test_title: PYST 41: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 05 Mar, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A, B and C are three students. A got 25 percent more marks than B and 10 percent less marks than C. If B got 324 marks, then what are the marks got by C ?
solution:
**Given:**

A got 25% more marks than B.

A got 10% less marks than C.

B got 324 marks.

**Formula Used:**

A = B + 25% of B

A = C - 10% of C

**Calculation:**

From the given data:

B = 324 marks

A = 324 + (25/100) × 324

A = 324 + 81

⇒ A = 405 marks

A = C - (10/100) × C

⇒ 405 = C - 0.1C

⇒ 405 = 0.9C

⇒ C = 405 / 0.9

⇒ C = 450 marks

**The marks got by C are 450.**
